factcheck.claim: Zapier Free: 100 tasks/month, two-step Zaps, unlimited Zaps within task limit, 15-min polling; Professional from $19.99/mo yearly or $29.99 monthly for 750 tasks
Zapier Free excludes Filters, Paths, Formatter, webhooks and premium apps (Help Center Formatter article: grey X for Free)
Zapier triggers and polling do not count toward the task limit; a task = a successful action
Make Free: 1,000 credits/month, routers & filters, 15-minute minimum interval; Core adds unlimited active scenarios and schedules down to the minute
Make Free allows 2 active scenarios (not printed on Make's pricing page; Core lists Unlimited active scenarios)
A Make scheduled trigger check costs 1 credit even with no new data; 'Running every 5 minutes = 288 credits per day' covers the trigger module only
Make Router and error-handler modules use no credits; reading data from an app or webhook counts as a credit
Out of quota: Make scenarios stop and webhooks queue; Zapier holds runs (or pauses) and pay-per-task is not available on Free
Make Core 10,000 credits: sources disagree ($9 annual/$10.59 monthly in our Oct 17 capture and Jet Admin; $12 annual per Zapier blog/usecarly) — post states a $9–$12 range
